body:
Scope: B-2026-09-15-14 (self-reflection loop — post-turn "what did I miss"
assessment stored as atomic lessons). Owner design gate resolved first
(P-2026-09-16-36 §2): proactive/autonomous memory writes must be VISIBLE
(log/UI), not silent — asked and confirmed 2026-09-18.

Plan: extend the existing post-response self-critique in
`core/engine/_reflection_mixin.py::_reflect_on_answer` (already runs on a
gated intent set after substantive turns) to ask the same reflection LLM
call for one extra structured field — a generalized LESSON describing the
PATTERN behind an issue, not the one-off instance — and store it via the
existing `_MemoryMixin._store_fact_if_valid` gate (ADR-63 durability/dedup/
keyed-upsert, source="reflection"). Add a `kind_override` param there so the
stored row is tagged `memory_kind: "lesson"`. No extra LLM call, no new
write-path door — reuses ADR-63's mechanics per the research doc's own
recommendation.

Visibility: a dedicated `reflection_lesson_stored` obs event, forwarded by
`api/routes/chat.py`'s existing turn_complete drain loop as a new top-level
SSE type `{"type": "reflection_lesson", ...}` (same pattern as the
context-usage-breakdown feature). Frontend: new `reflectionLessons` state
in `useLocalMind.ts::useChat`, rendered as a small clickable badge + popover
in `CenterPanel.tsx` (mirrors the context-breakdown popover).

Paths claimed (isolated worktree `../LocalMind-juma-s017`,
branch `collab/S017/juma-s017`):
- backend/src/core/engine/_reflection_mixin.py
- backend/src/core/engine/_memory_mixin.py
- backend/src/api/routes/chat.py
- frontend/src/types/index.ts
- frontend/src/hooks/useLocalMind.ts
- frontend/src/components/layout/CenterPanel.tsx
- frontend/src/components/layout/WorkspaceLayout.tsx

Disjoint from Kamau/S018 (deduction engine, B-2026-09-15-13 — signal fusion,
likely loop.py/agent/deduction-shaped files) and Amara/S019 (tier
classification regression tests, B-2026-08-15-12). No overlap expected;
will re-check before integrating.
